old_caption: The video showcases the process of cleaning a rug using a long-handled squeegee. The setting is an indoor space, likely a workshop or a dedicated cleaning facility, characterized by white walls and a white tarp covering the floor. The rug, a light beige color, is laid out on the tarp. A person wearing protective gear, including gloves and boots, operates the squeegee, moving it back-and-forth across the surface of the rug to agitate and extract water and dirt from the rug fibers. The action is part of the extraction phase. The camera is static and does not pan. The video transitions to a wider shot showing a different person and a different rug.
original_wisa_caption:
The video showcases the process of cleaning a rug using a specialized cleaning machine. The setting is an indoor space, likely a workshop or a dedicated cleaning facility, characterized by white walls and a concrete floor. The rug, a light beige color, is laid out on a large white surface, possibly a tarp or a mat, to protect the floor beneath it from water and cleaning solutions.

Initially, the video captures a person wearing protective gear, including gloves and boots, operating a cleaning machine equipped with a blue brush attachment. This individual moves the machine back and forth across the rug, applying a cleaning solution that creates a soapy lather. The brush agitates the solution into the rug fibers, ensuring thorough cleaning.

As the cleaning progresses, the camera pans slightly to reveal more of the workspace. Various cleaning supplies and equipment are visible in the background, indicating a professional setup. The person continues their methodical cleaning, covering different sections of the rug to ensure no area is overlooked.

Throughout the video,
caption:
The video showcases an indoor rug-cleaning bay where a worker in white rubber boots, dark trousers and black gloves stands on a white waterproof tarp, holding a long-handled tool with a blue head. A rectangular tan shaggy rug lies flat to the right, while brown, dirty water pools and streaks along the left edge of the tarp. The worker's hands rock the tool along that wet line.

Wall-mounted cleaning tools, including squeegees labelled PROTIME, hang against the white block wall behind the worker, beneath a printed mountain logo. Midway through the clip the close, downward-tilted view cross-dissolves into a wider, more level framing, briefly overlapping two images of the worker and the room. This is an editing transition rather than a continuous camera move.

From the new angle the worker draws the blue squeegee head along the left trench with small back-and-forth strokes. A workbench with bottles, a wooden door and a blue floor blower appear, while the brown water streak on the tarp stays largely static.

The rug stays.
